newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 105-day T-bill yields 18.87 pct at auction.
newsitem.headline: Russian 105-day T-bill yields 18.87 pct at auction.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 105-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 18.87 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
The yield was the lowest ever recorded at an auction of Russian T-bills, although yields have been lower in trading in the secondary market.
Dealers had forecast the average yield would be in the 15.85-19.26 percent range.
The 22060 bills, maturing on September 17, 1997, the closest maturity to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 95.80 to yield 16.16 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:

On June 11, the Finance Ministry will also repay 10.47 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of 154-day T-bills (series 22066) and pay 284.62 billion roubles in interest on the OFZ interest-bearing government bond (series 24007) maturing in March 1998.
